drivers.lead: Three drivers share the record on five wins each, and the last of the fifteen between them came in 2011
drivers.note: Marcel Tiemann and Timo Bernhard took four of theirs together, 2006 to 2009, in the same Manthey Racing Porsche — so two of the three record holders built most of their totals in one car with one team. Tiemann's fifth had come first, in an Opel in 2003; Bernhard's came last, back at Manthey in 2011. Pedro Lamy's are the odd set: 2001, 2002, 2004, 2005 and 2010, none of them shared with the other two, and the last three with BMW's Schnitzer squad. All three have stopped racing, which is why the record has not moved in fifteen years. Several drivers have four. What makes five hard is that this is one twenty-four-hour race a year rather than a season: it is not a matter of being consistently quick, but of five separate years in which a car survives a full day and night of the Nordschleife.
